newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's confirms Alcoa, Alcoa Australia, WMC.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's confirms Alcoa, Alcoa Australia, WMC.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it had confirmed the Prime-1 rating for commercial paper of Alcoa of Australia Ltd.

In a related action, Moody's also confirmed the debt ratings of The Aluminium Company of America (Alcoa), which owns 60 percent of Alcoa of Australia, as well as for certain guaranteed subsidiaries of WMC Ltd, a 39.25 percent owner of Alcoa of Australia.
The ratings agency said the confirmations followed Alcoa of Australia's announcement of a A$300 million decapitalisation that would return about A$180 million to Alcoa and A$118 millon to WMC.
It said the debt debt rating of WMC Finance Ltd was confirmed at Prime 1 for its commercial paper, and WMC Finance (USA) Ltd had its A2 senior unsecured debt confirmed.
Also confirmed were Aluminum Co of America's Prime 1 commercial paper rating, its A1 senior notes, medium term notes and IRB rating and the a1 preferred stock.
